about: The campfire's flame as a looping 3D volume (D493): fire round g23's Mantaflow sim F (96 cells over a 1.6 x 1.6 x 2.2 m domain, vorticity 0.8, flame vorticity 1.5, a gusting side wind of 1.8 m/s mean along +x, the clock in real seconds; g23's sim.py), its flame and temperature at the sim's own 2.3 cm cells in a 40 x 36 x 52 box round where it reaches (0.92 x 0.82 x 1.19 m, the wind along x), 8 s at 30 fps from 3 s in, the second after the loop blended into its start.
